read.thesis: Q4 CY25 net income fell to $266M ($1.82 diluted) from $404M in Q3 as steel margins compressed, though management says flat-rolled pricing is improving and aluminum is ramping at a loss.

utilisation.quote: Successful production and qualifications of industrial, beverage can, and automotive quality flat rolled aluminum products

triggers.label: Steel pricing has improved
triggers.quote: Steel pricing has improved, and customer optimism remains solid across our businesses, as demand continues to be steady.

triggers.label: Imports declined from H1 levels
triggers.quote: We also achieved record annual steel shipments as imports declined from the elevated levels experienced during the first half of the year

triggers.label: Flat-rolled realisations lagging contracts
triggers.quote: Average realized flat rolled steel pricing declined in the quarter based on lagging priced contracts

triggers.label: Aluminum ramp still loss-making
triggers.quote: the team has strong momentum and achieved positive EBITDA in December

guidance.value: Improving conditions expected; no numeric guidance
guidance.quote: we believe a favorable market environment will follow

red_flags.label: Q4 operating income down 35% QoQ
red_flags.quote: operating income for the company's steel operations was $322 million, or 35 percent lower than sequential third quarter results
